query: SHOW INDEXES YIELD name, state, labelsOrTypes, properties WHERE name = 'gsp_cost_lookup' RETURN name, state, labelsOrTypes, properties
MATCH ()-[r:GSP_FORWARD]->() RETURN count(DISTINCT r.pair) AS count
MATCH (u)-[f:GSP_FORWARD]->(v) OPTIONAL MATCH (v)-[b:GSP_REVERSE]->(u) WHERE b.pair = f.pair WITH f, count(b) AS inverse_count WHERE inverse_count <> 1 RETURN count(f) AS count
MATCH ()-[r:GSP_REVERSE]->() RETURN count(DISTINCT r.pair) AS count
MATCH (u)-[f:GSP_REVERSE]->(v) OPTIONAL MATCH (v)-[b:GSP_FORWARD]->(u) WHERE b.pair = f.pair WITH f, count(b) AS inverse_count WHERE inverse_count <> 1 RETURN count(f) AS count
